activities.name: Changi arrival formalities and hotel transfer
activities.transport: Airport MRT via Tanah Merah or taxi/Grab depending on hotel and luggage.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Approximate arrival only; use existing flight record. Immigration and baggage collection before transfer; allow for delays.

activities.name: Hotel check-in and freshen up
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Hotel undecided. Contextual preparation block only; no hotel selection, reservation or expense added.

activities.name: Travel to Merlion Park
activities.transport: MRT to Raffles Place, then walk to Merlion Park.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Allow 45 minutes from the eventual hotel, including walking.

activities.name: Merlion Park
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Skyline views and photographs; free waterfront access.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands and The Shoppes
activities.transport: Walk via waterfront/Jubilee Bridge and Helix Bridge; Bayfront MRT nearby.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Walk around the bay (allow 20–30 minutes within this block). Browse The Shoppes, indoor canal and Rain Oculus water feature; operation subject to venue schedule. No SkyPark admission.

activities.name: Optional Sampan boat ride
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Optional paid ride within the Marina Bay Sands visit, not an additional hour. Only if time permits; price and operation pending. Excluded from forecast.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay — outdoor gardens and Supertree Grove
activities.transport: Walk via Bayfront pedestrian access; follow signs to Gardens by the Bay.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Separate attraction from Marina Bay Sands. Allow 15–20 minutes to walk from The Shoppes via Bayfront access. Public outdoor areas only; no Flower Dome, Cloud Forest or paid observatory tickets. Supersedes the old ₹3,000 illustrative paid-gardens placeholder.

activities.name: Garden Rhapsody — provisional light show
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Free Supertree light show. 19:45 is provisional: 30 January 2027 schedule could not be verified. Allow 19:30–19:45 to find a viewing spot. Check https://www.gardensbythebay.com.sg/en/things-to-do/calendar-of-events/garden-rhapsody.html before travel.

activities.name: Dinner and return to hotel
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Arrival evening includes sightseeing, not a rest day. Meal and transfer spending uses existing allowances.

activities.name: Breakfast and travel to Resorts World Sentosa
activities.transport: MRT to HarbourFront (NE1/CC29), walk through VivoCity to Sentosa Express at Level 3 for Resorts World station, or use Sentosa Boardwalk and walk to RWS. Allow for queues; verify access fares, no cable-car ticket assumed.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Breakfast then travel; adjust departure earlier once hotel is chosen. Sentosa access and admission are separate.

activities.name: Singapore Oceanarium
activities.transport: Walk from Resorts World station to Singapore Oceanarium; allow 10–15 minutes and entry queues.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Major planned paid attraction, not the former S.E.A. Aquarium. Admission price, date-specific hours and availability pending; book only after verification.

activities.name: Lunch at Resorts World Sentosa
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Includes short walks between venues; use existing meals allowance.

activities.name: Harry Potter: Visions of Magic — conditional
activities.transport: Walk within Resorts World Sentosa; allow entry and timed-slot queues.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Intended paid attraction, conditional on operation and availability on 31 January 2027. Could not verify that date. Check https://www.rwsentosa.com/en/attractions/harry-potter-visions-of-magic before booking; if unavailable, retain a relaxed RWS break, not a replacement paid attraction.

activities.name: Transfer to Skyline Luge
activities.transport: Walk to Resorts World station; Sentosa Express towards Beach station, then follow signs to Skyline Luge. Verify local shuttle/access closer to travel.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). 45-minute buffer for walking, waiting and transfer.

activities.name: Skyline Luge Singapore
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Plan approximately 3–4 rides, subject to eventual package and queues. Cost pending. Weather-dependent: in heavy rain/lightning, follow operator guidance, shelter nearby and shorten or skip luge/beach; do not prepay an invented indoor replacement.

activities.name: Siloso Beach — scenery and photographs
activities.transport: Walk towards Siloso Beach; optional beach shuttle subject to operation.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Walk from the luge/Beach station area, allowing 10–15 minutes. Relaxation, photographs and beach atmosphere; no swimming activity. Weather-dependent; shelter/return early if needed.

activities.name: Optional Palawan Beach walk
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Only within the beach block if time, energy and weather allow; not an extra scheduled stop. Allow additional walking or beach shuttle. No swimming.

activities.name: Dinner and return from Sentosa
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Use existing meals/transport allowances; allow return walk and Sentosa Express/Boardwalk to HarbourFront.

activities.name: Breakfast and travel to Sentosa
activities.transport: MRT to HarbourFront (NE1/CC29), walk through VivoCity to Sentosa Express at Level 3 for Resorts World station, or use Sentosa Boardwalk and walk to RWS. Allow for queues; verify access fares, no cable-car ticket assumed.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Allow a relaxed journey and admission queue; opening time remains provisional.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.transport: Walk from Resorts World station to park entrance; lunch/rest inside the park as needed.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Dedicated major paid-attraction day; enjoy rides without rushing. Existing ₹6,000 illustrative estimate retained, not a verified admission quote; price pending. No Express Pass included. Hours for 1 February 2027 unverified: adjust after checking https://www.rwsentosa.com/en/attractions/universal-studios-singapore. No Oceanarium, Harry Potter or Luge scheduled today.

activities.name: Exit Universal Studios, dinner and return
activities.transport: MRT to HarbourFront (NE1/CC29), walk through VivoCity to Sentosa Express at Level 3 for Resorts World station, or use Sentosa Boardwalk and walk to RWS. Allow for queues; verify access fares, no cable-car ticket assumed.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Allow exit queues, dinner and travel towards the hotel; meals covered by existing allowance.

activities.name: Flexible evening leisure
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Unstructured evening near hotel; no substantial sightseeing commitment.

activities.name: Little India
activities.transport: MRT to Little India (NE7/DT12), then walk.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Cultural sightseeing, neighbourhood streets and photography.

activities.name: Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple area
activities.transport: Walk along Serangoon Road; then MRT/bus or walk towards Kampong Glam as practical.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Neighbourhood exploration; respect worship, dress and photography restrictions. Allow walking and 15–20 minutes at end for onward transfer.

activities.name: Optional Mustafa Centre shopping
activities.transport: Near Farrer Park MRT; allow walking time.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Optional nearby stop only within the Little India block; shorten neighbourhood exploration if chosen. No additional spending estimate.

activities.name: Kampong Glam — Arab Street and Sultan Mosque
activities.transport: MRT towards Bugis (EW12/DT14), then walk; taxi/Grab optional.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Explore streets and mosque surroundings; access subject to visitor hours and worship. Include 15–20 minutes for arrival from Little India if needed.

activities.name: Lunch in Kampong Glam
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Use existing meals allowance; walk to Haji Lane afterwards.

activities.name: Haji Lane — street art and photographs
activities.transport: Walk within Kampong Glam; Bugis MRT nearby.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Street art, independent shops and photographs; include short walk from lunch.

activities.name: Bugis Street Market and Bugis Junction
activities.transport: Walk to Bugis Street Market/Bugis Junction near Bugis MRT.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Primary planned souvenir-shopping stop: affordable shopping and local character. Include 10–15-minute walk from Haji Lane. Browsing free; purchases use existing budgeting rules, no invented costs.

activities.name: Optional Chinatown or Clarke Quay, then dinner
activities.transport: MRT from Bugis via Downtown line towards Chinatown; Clarke Quay via suitable interchange, then walk. Allow 25–40 minutes.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Choose at most one if time and energy remain; otherwise dine near hotel. No Orchard Road requirement. Shopping/sightseeing optional; dinner uses existing allowance.

activities.name: Breakfast
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Relaxed final morning; existing meals allowance.

activities.name: Optional final shopping or neighbourhood walk
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Stay near the eventual hotel. End promptly to protect airport buffer; no substantial detour.

activities.name: Collect luggage and check out
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Return to hotel; collect luggage and check out. Context only: no hotel record or expense changed.

activities.name: Travel to Changi Airport / Jewel
activities.transport: MRT towards Changi Airport via Tanah Merah; follow Jewel signs. Confirm service and route closer to travel.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). 90-minute allowance from the eventual hotel including walking, waits and luggage. Taxi/Grab optional if delays arise; no invented fare.

activities.name: Jewel Changi — Rain Vortex and shopping
activities.transport: Walk via Jewel landside links; allow onward terminal transfer.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Jewel is landside. Rain Vortex photographs, browsing and shopping; verify operating hours. Keep luggage unless airline storage/check-in arrangements are confirmed. Do not assume early airline baggage check-in at Jewel. No paid attractions automatically included.

activities.name: Transfer to departure terminal and airline check-in
activities.transport: Follow confirmed airline/airport terminal guidance; use airport links or shuttle as appropriate.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Confirm AI 2108 departure terminal and check-in arrangements closer to travel. Terminal unknown; do not assume T2 or early check-in. Allow walking, inter-terminal transfer and luggage handling.

activities.name: International departure formalities and airport buffer
activities.transport: MRT and walking; taxi/Grab optional. Exact fares pending; existing transport allowance retained.
activities.notes: SGT (UTC+8). Check-in, baggage drop, immigration and security as applicable to the assigned terminal/gate. Confirm airline cutoffs; preserve buffer for the existing 19:40 AI 2108 flight. From 18:00 stay airside/near gate and follow boarding instructions. Flight remains a separate existing transport record; no duplicate flight activity or expense.
